name: FEYTECH
recent: Feytech 与两家中国公司签署谅解备忘录，探讨在马来西亚为 Chery 生产转向与制动系统等汽车底盘部件的合资机会。公司同时宣布每股 0.72 仙的 2026 财年中期单层股息，除息日为 12 月 4 日，派发日为 12 月 28 日。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收同比增 20.7%，净利同比增 40.6%。
notable: 与两家中国公司签署谅解备忘录，探讨为 Chery 在马来西亚本地化生产转向与制动系统等汽车底盘部件的合资机会。
宣布 2026 财年中期单层股息每股 0.72 仙，除息日 12 月 4 日，派发日 12 月 28 日。
子公司 FT Assembly 与关联公司 Evolvelectric Motors 签订装配协议，属经常性关联交易，估计总值达 100 万令吉或以上。
risks: 与关联公司 Evolvelectric Motors 的经常性关联交易估计总值达 100 万令吉或以上，需留意关联交易性质。
谅解备忘录仅属探讨性质，尚未构成具约束力的合资协议。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 3844 万令吉，环比减 1.3%，同比增 20.7%；净利为 425 万令吉，环比增 5.5%，同比增 40.6%；净利率 11.1%，高于上季的 10.3%。

recent_en: Feytech signed an MoU with two Chinese firms to explore a joint venture to manufacture steering and braking systems and other chassis components for Chery in Malaysia. The company also declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.72 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 4 December and payment on 28 December. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 20.7% YoY and net profit rose 40.6% YoY.
notable_en: Signed an MoU with two Chinese firms to explore a joint venture to localise steering and braking systems and other chassis components for Chery in Malaysia.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.72 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 4 December and payment on 28 December.
Subsidiary FT Assembly entered into an assembly agreement with related party Evolvelectric Motors, a recurrent related party transaction with estimated aggregate value of RM1 million or more.
risks_en: The recurrent related party transaction with Evolvelectric Motors has an estimated aggregate value of RM1 million or more; note the related party nature.
The MoU is exploratory only and does not yet constitute a binding joint venture agreement.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM38.44 million, down 1.3% QoQ but up 20.7% YoY; net profit was RM4.25 million, up 5.5% QoQ and up 40.6% YoY; net margin was 11.1%, higher than 10.3% in the previous quarter.
